sources.text:
The ladies at Basileas Minis
All of our girls are fully health tested prior to breeding which includes a full DNA breed panel, hips & elbows xrayed, patellas checked and cleared of LTV.
We are lucky to work with great placement families so not all of our girls live with us but are placed in their own families where they enjoy individual attention and training without ever being held in kennels. This helps us maintain a big and healthy gene pool.

Ryder is a super cool little boy. He joined us at 9 months of age and was home right away. He knows no stranger, has the biggest wiggle bum and greets everyone in a very sweet manner whether two or four legged. He loves kids and cuddles in general.
The day after he arrived in Germany we took him on a week long holiday hiking in the Swiss mountains. This little dude loved it all and wasnt phased by anything. He came on train, car, bus, cable car and even a chair lift. He loves all the attention, walks nicely on a lead and loves to carry things around in his mouth. When he found a hat on one of our hikes he carried it all the way down the mountain!
Ryder is only available to females with a full AKC/FCI pedigree.

sources.title: Puppies · Basileas Minis
sources.text:
We welcomed a beautiful litter from Billie & Zane
**2x black tri girls with blue eyes AVAILABLE**
​ready for new homes end of November
(this litter is based in Scotland, transport will be offered)
Important, please read:
Although we will always keep in mind the colour, markings and gender preferences of our puppy buyers, we do not place our pups based solely on colour, markings or gender.  We evaluate the pups temperament, structure and toy drive and puppies are matched with their new owners.  The selection is determined by 6-7 weeks of age.  Reservations are honoured and based upon suitability of each pup to each individual home.
​
Any payments made to reserve a puppy are non-refundable.
​
Also please remember we do NOT guarantee a pups height once fully grown. We are dealing with mother nature and although we can give a good estimate at 8 weeks this can never be guaranteed and should not be the deciding factor when getting a MAS.
We do not have any kennels and each litter is born in our bedroom before they are moved to the living room at around 3-4 weeks of age into a large puppy play pen. They will be exposed to a variety of different environments, toys, & surfaces (including a wobble board and wobble cushion). They will be given "
early neurological stimulation
".  They regularly go in our garden in a large "puppy kindergarden" with even more wobble cushions and a large wobble bridge. All of our puppies will be litter box and crate trained and they will travel in a vehicle.  Our litters are registered with AKC and will be legible for registration with The Kennel Clubs Activity Register as a Miniature American Shepherd .
For more information on puppy buyer etiquette please take the time to read the following:
https://rufflyspeaking.wordpress.com/2009/04/26/puppy-buyer-ettiquette/
